remarks: Crafted from mahogany, steel and stucco with exterior design by renowned Bassam and Fellowes, this striking contemporary is sited high on Ponus Ridge. The light filled interior features custom designed walls of glass that open to lovely courtyards. Throughout you'll appreciate the attention to detail and high end finishes. All 5 bedrooms, including 2 master suites, are on the main level. The gallery like layout of this home is an art collectors dream. A state of the art kitchen has European porcelain floors and Brazilian quartzite countertops. It opens to a stone patio perfect for entertaining: a built in bbq, gas firepit and a "summer kitchen" in the garage. Downstairs there is room to exercise, hang out or savor wine from the cellar. The flat, professionally landscaped 2 acre retreat has amazing sunsets in the front and salt water pool, spa and tennis court in the back. You'll never want to leave.
